scope: Local compatibility assembly only, not a fourth completed building. Two images are Blender studio renders, not Unity screenshots. No full-house decoration, entrance, furnishing or containment criteria applied.

images.observation: 实际逐图看过的局部组合棚拍：陡A梁架、多块地板、侧填充和前山墙同一暖木体系，前柱/横梁/屋面大形对齐，无可见大范围穿插；地板重复纹明显，侧填充底部/柱边有亮缝。背侧斜撑在此机位遮挡，不能用组合透视推翻侧墙单件悬空证据。
前视梁架、山墙和地板尺度相对关系合理，地板位于两柱内；山墙两条斜上缘到椽下有连续开放亮带，符合报告所称通风留空，但不是封闭防雨墙；地板与柱有侧间隙，不能据此称房体气密、角色可通过或碰撞无问题。

findings: Visible major frame/floor/gable placement is coherent; no obvious broad interpenetration in these two views.
Gable upper-perimeter opening and floor/column gaps remain visible; described ventilation/envelope clearances do not demonstrate weatherproof enclosure.
Side brace failure from standalone side images remains blocking; these views obscure that depth separation. Updated assembly images required after side-infill repair.
boundary: Both listed images actually viewed sequentially with view_image after maker confirmed complete set. Originals archived byte-for-byte before upcoming rework. No source/model/image edit, no render execution, no user computer, no Codex, no Unity pass claim.
